description.zh: 模拟 compact.rs 的三条压缩触发路径：预压缩（PreTurn）→ 轮中压缩（MidTurn）→ 手动压缩（Manual）。核心流程：调模型生成摘要 → collect_user_messages() → build_compacted_history() → replace_compacted_history()。
description.en: Simulate compact.rs three compaction trigger paths: PreTurn, MidTurn, Manual. Core flow: call model for summary → collect_user_messages() → build_compacted_history() → replace_compacted_history().

annotation.zh: turn.rs:474 — total_tokens(148K) ≥ auto_compact_limit(120K)，触发预压缩条件成立
annotation.en: turn.rs:474 — total_tokens(148K) ≥ auto_compact_limit(120K), PreTurn compaction triggered

annotation.zh: compact.rs:157 — run_compact_task_inner_impl() 调用 drain_to_completed()，模型消费完整历史后输出摘要
annotation.en: compact.rs:157 — run_compact_task_inner_impl() calls drain_to_completed(), model consumes full history and outputs summary

annotation.zh: compact.rs — collect_user_messages() 过滤非摘要用户消息；build_compacted_history() 按 token 预算保留，从旧到新反向选取
annotation.en: compact.rs — collect_user_messages() filters non-summary user messages; build_compacted_history() selects within token budget, newest-first reverse selection

annotation.zh: compact.rs — replace_compacted_history() 原子替换历史；DoNotInject 时 reference_context_item=None，下一轮 turn 会完整重注入初始 context
annotation.en: compact.rs — replace_compacted_history() atomically replaces history; with DoNotInject, reference_context_item=None, next turn fully re-injects initial context

annotation.zh: 压缩完成后 turn 继续，用户消息进入压缩后的历史
annotation.en: After compaction, turn continues with user message entering compacted history

annotation.zh: turn.rs:492 — 轮中压缩触发：BeforeLastUserMessage 与 PreTurn 的 DoNotInject 不同，确保模型在压缩后看到正确的对话结构
annotation.en: turn.rs:492 — MidTurn compaction: BeforeLastUserMessage differs from PreTurn's DoNotInject, ensuring correct conversation structure after compaction

annotation.zh: compact.rs — BeforeLastUserMessage 将初始 context 插入最后一条用户消息之前，reference_context_item 设为 Some，阻止下一轮重复注入
annotation.en: compact.rs — BeforeLastUserMessage inserts initial context before last user message; reference_context_item set to Some, preventing re-injection next turn

annotation.zh: compact.rs — 手动压缩先发 TurnStarted 事件，完成后发 Warning 提示用户频繁压缩会降低模型准确性
annotation.en: compact.rs — manual compaction emits TurnStarted first, then Warning after completion about accuracy degradation from frequent compaction
